comments.author: Nour
comments.body:
Confirmed Repeatable.

IN FACT, you can take this quest and enter Xanadu without having to do the 50+ monstrosity.

The reason is that the quest has the title needed to enter Xanadu, just like the other Xanadu quests, 14th Century.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Good tip, thanks for reposting it here. But to clarify: entering Xanadu only allows you access to the item shop which sells some unique Mongolian outfits, little more.

In order to unlock numerous discovery maps and quests requiring the Xanadu discovery card, you cannot avoid completing the 50+ monstrosity. Cheers.
